faq.q: How much does electrical work cost?
faq.a: Most YES jobs run between $400 and $15,000+, depending on the scope — a single outlet or fixture is at the low end; a full panel upgrade, whole-home rewire, or generator install is at the high end. Every quote is free and given in writing before we start — no surprises.

We serve all of Miami-Dade and Broward counties — from Brickell, Coral Gables, and Pinecrest up through Fort Lauderdale, Pembroke Pines, and Weston. Every call is geo-tagged by ZIP and routed to the nearest available truck.

Yes. Estimates are always free and there's no obligation. Call, text, or snap a photo of your panel or the area you need wired and we'll give you an illustrative range up front, then confirm the exact price with a free on-site visit.

Yes — every job is performed by a licensed electrician, and our Florida electrical contractor license number of record is displayed on all public-facing material. Permits are pulled where required by local code, and work is inspected accordingly.

faq.q: Do you have a Spanish line?
faq.a: Sí. We're a bilingual team and run a dedicated Spanish route — se habla español. Pick your language at the top of this page and the site and our concierge respond in it.

faq.q: Can you install an EV charger or generator?
faq.a: Absolutely — Level 2 EV charger installs and standby or portable generator sizing and installation, including transfer-switch wiring, are two of our fastest-growing services.

faq.q: What happens during a storm or outage?
faq.a: Storm power restoration is one of our specialties, and YES is an enrolled vendor on the WIN storm-dispatch network. When a South Florida storm passes, outage and downed-line leads route straight to the nearest available truck for a fast quote and priority service.
